```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

<br>
**1. load packages**
```{r load packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(BiocManager)
library(DESeq2)
library(knitr)
#library(UpSetR)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggradar)
```

<br>
**2. set up script (clean environment, set working directory, set global options)**
```{r housekeeping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("/PATH")
```

<br>
**3. create gene count matrix**
```{r matrix, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
file_list <- list.files("count_tables", pattern = "counts.short.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

##Merging the Files into a single data frames
#Format Names
GeneID <- read.delim("count_tables/WP2-RNA-26-euk_S22.counts.short.txt", header=TRUE)
GeneID <- GeneID$Geneid
GeneID <- as.data.frame(GeneID)

#bind the second column from each file into one file, make the rownames the Gene_ID
df <- do.call(cbind,lapply(file_list,function(fn)read.delim(fn,header=TRUE)[,7]))
rownames(df) <- GeneID$GeneID
df <- as.data.frame(df)

#make the colnames according to sample names, reformat the names
temp = as.data.frame(list.files("count_tables", pattern="*"))
colnames(temp) <- 'FileName'

#set sample names 
temp$SampleName <- sub("\\..*$", "", temp$FileName)
names <- temp
colnames(df) <- names$SampleName

#create matrix
count_mat <- as.matrix(df)

```

<br>
**4. create meta file**
```{r sample-info,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sample_info <- read_xlsx("wp2_meta.xlsx")
df_rownames <- sample_info$Sample
sample_info <- sample_info[,1:3]
rownames(sample_info) <- df_rownames
```

<br>
**5. create metafile and matrix subsets**<br>
Note, that it is recommended to keep the design as simple as possible to obtain interpetable results.
Therefore,we create multiple deseq objects for each condition that will be analysed separately to reduce the dimensionality.
```{r subsetting,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#start with metafiles
invisible(capture.output({
meta_t9_p16 <- dplyr::filter(sample_info, Temperature == "9", Photoperiod == "16")
droplevels(meta_t9_p16)

meta_t9_p24 <- dplyr::filter(sample_info, Temperature == "9", Photoperiod == "24")
droplevels(meta_t9_p24)

meta_t13_p16 <- dplyr::filter(sample_info, Temperature == "13.5", Photoperiod == "16")
droplevels(meta_t13_p16)

meta_t13_p24 <- dplyr::filter(sample_info, Temperature == "13.5", Photoperiod == "24")
droplevels(meta_t13_p24)

#now create matrix subsets based on the samples in subsetted metafiles
mat_t9_p16 <- count_mat[, rownames(meta_t9_p16), drop = FALSE]
mat_t9_p24 <- count_mat[, rownames(meta_t9_p24), drop = FALSE]
mat_t13_p16 <- count_mat[, rownames(meta_t13_p16), drop = FALSE]
mat_t13_p24 <- count_mat[, rownames(meta_t13_p24), drop = FALSE]
}))
```

<br>
**6. create DEseq2 object (via DESeqDataSet)**
```{r deseq,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#create DESeqDataSets from subsets
invisible(capture.output({
dds_t9_p16 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mat_t9_p16,
                              colData = meta_t9_p16,
                              design= ~ Bacteria)

dds_t9_p24 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mat_t9_p24,
                              colData = meta_t9_p24,
                              design= ~ Bacteria)

dds_t13_p16 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mat_t13_p16,
                              colData = meta_t13_p16,
                              design= ~ Bacteria)

dds_t13_p24 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mat_t13_p24,
                              colData = meta_t13_p24,
                              design= ~ Bacteria)

#also, we will create one object containing all data
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat,
                              colData = sample_info,
                              design= ~ Temperature+Photoperiod+Bacteria)



#remove rows with low read counts
dds_t9_p16  <- dds_t9_p16[rowSums(counts(dds_t9_p16))>10]
dds_t9_p24  <- dds_t9_p24[rowSums(counts(dds_t9_p24))>10]
dds_t13_p16  <- dds_t13_p16[rowSums(counts(dds_t13_p16))>10]
dds_t13_p24  <- dds_t13_p24[rowSums(counts(dds_t13_p24))>10]
dds  <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds))>10]

#create DESeq objects
dds_t9_p16  <- DESeq(dds_t9_p16)
dds_t9_p24  <- DESeq(dds_t9_p24)
dds_t13_p16  <- DESeq(dds_t13_p16)
dds_t13_p24  <- DESeq(dds_t13_p24)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

}))
#inspect objects
dds_t9_p16
dds_t9_p24
dds_t13_p16
dds_t13_p24
dds

```

<br>
**7. PCA of overall DESeq results**<br>
Therefore, we will have a look at the dds object containing all samples, not the subsetted ones.
```{r plotting,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#PCA of all samples
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=FALSE)

vsd_df <- data.frame(assay(vsd))

#If you want to do boxplots of the diff expr. analysis (of some specific genes) access the results like this:
#vsd_sub <- subset(vsd_df, rownames(vsd_df) == "cds.NODE_10026_length_2545_cov_452.071314_g5961_i0.p1")

#PCA of the 500 most variable expressed genes

pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup=c("Temperature", "Photoperiod", "Bacteria"), returnData =TRUE)
head(pca)

# Calculate explained variance
variance <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"), 2)

pca500 <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, color=Temperature, shape=Photoperiod, group = Bacteria)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  coord_fixed()+
  scale_color_viridis_d()+
  theme_few()+
  ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(aes(fill = Bacteria))+
    labs(x = paste("PC1 (", variance[1], "%)", sep=""),
       y = paste("PC2 (", variance[2], "%)", sep=""))

pca500

 #ggsave("PCA_diff500.eps", pca500, device = "eps", height = 4, width = 6, dpi = 320 )


# Plot PCA for all genes with different attributes for factors
pca <- prcomp(t(assay(vsd)))
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_data <- cbind(pca_scores, colData(vsd))

ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = Bacteria, color = factor(Temperature), size = factor(Photoperiod)))+
  geom_point() +
  theme_few() +
  labs(color = "Temperature", size = "Photoperiod", shape = "Bacteria")

# Creating sample similarity heatmap
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))

library("RColorBrewer")
library("pheatmap")
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$Temperature, vsd$Photoperiod, vsd$Bacteria, sep="-")
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- NULL
colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         col=colors)
```

<br>
**8. Create results tables**<br>
Here we will extract results tables from deseq2. Those tables will be filtered for significant adjusted p-values and split into two dataframes for either up- or downregulated genes, respectively.
```{r result-tables,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_t9_p16 <- results(dds_t9_p16)
res_t9_p16 <- results(dds_t9_p16, contrast=c("Bacteria","xe","ax"))
res_t9_p16 <- as.data.frame(res_t9_p16)
res_t9_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p16, padj <= 0.05)
up_t9_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p16, log2FoldChange > 0)
down_t9_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p16, log2FoldChange < 0)

res_t9_p24 <- results(dds_t9_p24)
res_t9_p24 <- results(dds_t9_p24, contrast=c("Bacteria","xe","ax"))
res_t9_p24 <- as.data.frame(res_t9_p24)
res_t9_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p24, padj <= 0.05)
up_t9_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p24, log2FoldChange > 0)
down_t9_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t9_p24, log2FoldChange < 0)

res_t13_p16 <- results(dds_t13_p16)
res_t13_p16 <- results(dds_t13_p16, contrast=c("Bacteria","xe","ax"))
res_t13_p16 <- as.data.frame(res_t13_p16)
res_t13_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p16, padj <= 0.05)
up_t13_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p16, log2FoldChange > 0)
down_t13_p16 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p16, log2FoldChange < 0)

res_t13_p24 <- results(dds_t13_p24)
res_t13_p24 <- results(dds_t13_p24, contrast=c("Bacteria","xe","ax"))
res_t13_p24 <- as.data.frame(res_t13_p24)
res_t13_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p24, padj <= 0.05)
up_t13_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p24, log2FoldChange > 0)
down_t13_p24 <- dplyr::filter(res_t13_p24, log2FoldChange < 0)
```

<br>
**9. Creating upset plot**<br>
This plot illustrates the intersection of significantly up- or downregulated genes (i.e. contigs) among the different treatment combinations. Single dots represent unique genes in a respective treatment
```{r upset,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(UpSetR)
listInput <- list(upreg_t9_p16 = row.names(up_t9_p16), 
                  upreg_t9_p24 = row.names(up_t9_p24), 
                  upreg_t13_p16 = row.names(up_t13_p16), 
                  upreg_t13_p24 = row.names(up_t13_p24),
                  downreg_t9_p16 = row.names(down_t9_p16), 
                  downreg_t9_p24 = row.names(down_t9_p24), 
                  downreg_t13_p16 = row.names(down_t13_p16), 
                  downreg_t13_p24 = row.names(down_t13_p24))
order.by = "freq"
upset(fromList(listInput), order.by = "freq", nsets = 8, sets = c("upreg_t9_p16", "upreg_t9_p24", "upreg_t13_p16", "upreg_t13_p24",
                                                                  "downreg_t9_p16", "downreg_t9_p24", "downreg_t13_p16", "downreg_t13_p24"),
      keep.order = TRUE, sets.x.label = "Total Number of Contigs")
```

<br>
**10. Extracting intersections for overall xenic vs. axenic comparison**<br>
Lets make one subset for the intersection among all significantly differential expressed genes in the up-regulated and in the down-regulated dataset, respectively (temperature and photoperiod treatments will be pooled).
```{r extract intersections,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#extract intersect of up-regulated genes
intersect_up <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(up_t9_p16), rownames(up_t9_p24), rownames(up_t13_p16), rownames(up_t13_p24)))

#extract intersect of down-regulated genes
intersect_down <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(down_t9_p16), rownames(down_t9_p24), rownames(down_t13_p16), rownames(down_t13_p24)))

#import annotated transcriptome:
egg <- read_xlsx("/Users/jgiesler/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/PhD/Manuscripts/WP2_big/Transcriptomics/Eukaryotes/transcriptome annotation/MM_8j7rdz8b.emapper.annotations.xlsx")

#bind annotation info to intersections
intersect_up <- gsub("cds.", "", intersect_up)
intersect_up <- as.data.frame(intersect_up)
intersect_up <- dplyr::rename(intersect_up, "query" = intersect_up)
intersect_up <- left_join(intersect_up, egg, by="query")
#write_xlsx(intersect_up, "upregulated_in_xe.xlsx")
#intersect_up <- read_xlsx("upregulated_in_xe.xlsx")

intersect_down <- gsub("cds.", "", intersect_down)
intersect_down <- as.data.frame(intersect_down)
intersect_down <- dplyr::rename(intersect_down, "query" = intersect_down)
intersect_down <- left_join(intersect_down, egg, by="query")
#write_xlsx(intersect_down, "downregulated_in_xe.xlsx")
#intersect_down <- read_xlsx("downregulated_in_xe.xlsx")

con_up_t9_p16 <- rownames(up_t9_p16)
con_up_t9_p16 <- gsub("cds.", "", con_up_t9_p16)
con_up_t9_p16 <- as.data.frame(con_up_t9_p16)
con_up_t9_p16 <- dplyr::rename(con_up_t9_p16, "query" = con_up_t9_p16)
con_up_t9_p16 <- left_join(con_up_t9_p16, egg, by="query")
#write_xlsx(con_up_t9_p16, "up_t9_p16.xlsx")

write_xlsx(down_t9_p16, "down_t9_p16.xlsx")

write_xlsx(up_t9_p24, "up_t9_p24.xlsx")
write_xlsx(down_t9_p24, "down_t9_p24.xlsx")

write_xlsx(up_t13_p16, "up_t13_p16.xlsx")
write_xlsx(down_t13_p16, "down_t13_p16.xlsx")

write_xlsx(up_t13_p24, "up_t13_p24.xlsx")
write_xlsx(down_t13_p24, "down_t13_p24.xlsx")

```
